title: Magnitude FFT
text: 输入的离散余弦变换 (DCT)，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式；{Sine and cosine computation} 指定正弦和余弦计算 Table、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Sine table} 指定正弦表、{Product output}、{Accumulator}、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 输出最小值、{Output Maximum} 输出最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input 1
ports.summary: 输入信号 vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output 1
ports.summary: DCT 输出 vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Sine and cosine computation
params.values: 正弦和余弦计算 Table lookup (default) | Trigonometric fcn

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Sine table
params.values: 正弦表 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
